title: Paginate the task list API
body:
The owner UI times out on briefs with thousands of tasks because GET /api/v1/tasks returns everything.

- Add `limit` and `offset` query parameters to GET /api/v1/tasks. Default limit 100, maximum 1000; reject negative or non-numeric values with 400.
- Add `--limit` and `--offset` flags to `subspacectl tasks list` and follow pages automatically with `--all`.
- Update docs/api.md so the contract test keeps passing.

Out of scope: cursor-based pagination.

repos.name: SigmaUno/subspace
repos.description: Go server, MCP tools, subspacectl CLI and docs/api.md (checked by internal/server/contract_test.go)

requirements.title: Add limit and offset pagination to GET /api/v1/tasks
Add --limit, --offset and --all to subspacectl tasks list
Document task list pagination in docs/api.md
